storage-port.writeReceipt.rejectionRelation: Concurrent applying owner, root mismatch, missing/corrupt component, publish-after-abort, or abort-after-publication rejects.
storage-port.writeReceipt.resultMapping: Storage observations map to invisible staged state, exact published world, compact replay receipt, terminal abort, or repair outcome.
storage-port.writeReceipt.retryRelation: Exact begin/complete retry returns frozen plan/receipt; changed fingerprint or stale base rejects.

storage-port.writeReservations.inputMapping: Base revision/root, intent fingerprint, complete next-world plan, component roots, operation ID, and failpoint stage map to applying/published/completed/aborted protocol state.
storage-port.writeReservations.rejectionRelation: Concurrent applying owner, root mismatch, missing/corrupt component, publish-after-abort, or abort-after-publication rejects.
storage-port.writeReservations.resultMapping: Storage observations map to invisible staged state, exact published world, compact replay receipt, terminal abort, or repair outcome.
storage-port.writeReservations.retryRelation: Exact begin/complete retry returns frozen plan/receipt; changed fingerprint or stale base rejects.

allocation-helper.inputMapping: Candidates, selector, amount, method, expiry, package increment, and reservation context map to exact finite allocation choices.
allocation-helper.rejectionRelation: Invalid increment, incompatible revision/unit, shortfall where full allocation is required, or reservation violation rejects/reports explicitly.
allocation-helper.resultMapping: Plan/result reports exact lines, allocated total, shortfall, and blocked/excluded evidence without mutating state.
allocation-helper.retryRelation: Pure planning is deterministic for one frozen world.

authority-control.inputMapping: Authority mode, activation provenance, certification, mutually exclusive deployment authorization, writer/fence tokens, source/target roots, mismatch, and projection evidence map directly to the writer-fence state machine.
authority-control.rejectionRelation: Missing prerequisites, active writers, mixed authorization modes, nonempty greenfield target, mismatch, source drift, downgrade, or competing CAS rejects.
authority-control.resultMapping: Result maps to one monotonic authority document revision and exact retained legacy-cutover or greenfield evidence.
authority-control.retryRelation: Exact CAS intent is idempotent; conflicting token/evidence/authorization or stale document rejects.

authority-cutover.inputMapping: Certification plus exactly one explicit authorization mode maps either to stable-source fence/migration activation or to certified canonical revision-zero greenfield activation.
authority-cutover.rejectionRelation: Source drift, active writer, blocked migration, nonempty greenfield target, mixed authorization modes, adapter uncertified, mismatch, or failed publication blocks activation.
authority-cutover.resultMapping: Result maps to authoritative state with disjoint legacy-cutover or greenfield provenance and exact target revision/root.
authority-cutover.retryRelation: Exact activation retry resumes retained evidence; changed source/fence/migration/greenfield authorization or target evidence rejects.

catalog-definition.inputMapping: Definition fields map to immutable revision IDs, exact vectors, membership sets, and active pointers.
catalog-definition.rejectionRelation: Redefinition, missing revision, duplicate identity, ambiguous package, or invalid graph rejects.
catalog-definition.resultMapping: Result is one immutable validated catalogue/revision with deterministic digest.
catalog-definition.retryRelation: Pure definition helpers have no durable retry identity.

catalog-publication.inputMapping: Published catalogue snapshot and operation identity map to retained meanings and one abstract publication step.
catalog-publication.rejectionRelation: Stale base, immutable redefinition, missing retained meanings, and changed retry reject.
catalog-publication.resultMapping: Result maps to published revision, optional catalog event, replay flag, and unchanged physical buckets.
catalog-publication.retryRelation: Exact intent replays the same receipt; changed catalogue under the same operation ID rejects.

collection-read.inputMapping: Collection revision and optional scope map to frozen member identities and selector constraints.
collection-read.rejectionRelation: Unknown revisions, invalid cycles, duplicate membership, or incompatible roll-up units reject.
collection-read.resultMapping: Definition/summary preserves member identity and derives exact per-member/roll-up observations only.

composition-open.inputMapping: Opening ID, source package revision/count, placements, and composition revision map to one atomic consume/produce transition.
composition-open.rejectionRelation: Wrong package revision, non-whole count, conflicting placement, insufficient stock, or invalid genealogy rejects atomically.
composition-open.resultMapping: Result maps to one opening, exact component buckets, genealogy, revision, and replay observation.
composition-open.retryRelation: Exact opening intent replays once; changed revision/vector/placement under the same ID rejects.

composition-read.inputMapping: Revision/source package identities map to one retained composition revision.
composition-read.rejectionRelation: Unknown, inactive, or ambiguous source-package lookups reject.
composition-read.resultMapping: Returned definition preserves exact source and component vector identity.
composition-read.retryRelation: Read is side-effect-free; repeated reads of one snapshot are equal.

container-command.inputMapping: Container identity/metadata or whole-container action maps to one handling-unit master/containment/resource transition.
container-command.rejectionRelation: Unknown container, cycle, mixed illegal source, reservation conflict, or invalid correction rejects atomically.
container-command.resultMapping: Result preserves exact contained stock identities, effective use-by, metadata correction history, event, revision, and replay.
container-command.retryRelation: Exact container command replays once; changed metadata/action/destination rejects.

correction.inputMapping: Corrected root/event reference and replacement plans map to append-only compensating facts, never deletion or mutation of retained history.
correction.rejectionRelation: Unknown root, correction cycles, over-correction, invalid replacement, or stale base rejects atomically.
correction.resultMapping: Result exposes the correction event, retained root chain, revised projection, revision, and replay.
correction.retryRelation: Exact correction intent replays once; changed replacement/supersession under one ID rejects.

count.inputMapping: Count identity, frozen selector/revision, snapshot sequence, observations, position-when-empty, and lifecycle times map to snapshot/observe/discrepancy/reconcile states.
count.rejectionRelation: Ambiguous bucket, invalid observation, stale/missing stage, later-invalid lifecycle, or reservation conflict rejects safely.
count.resultMapping: Result maps to count lifecycle, discrepancy event if any, retained later movement, revision, and replay.
count.retryRelation: Each stage and replaceAbsolute resume/replay exact intent; changed observation/selector/reason rejects.

dimension-reclassification.inputMapping: Source/destination positions and changed status/owner/custodian/authority/container/qualified dimension map to one resource-key rewrite.
dimension-reclassification.rejectionRelation: Missing source, duplicate destination, implicit package conversion, or non-conservation rejects atomically.
dimension-reclassification.resultMapping: Result preserves item/package/measurement quantity and changes only declared dimensions.
dimension-reclassification.retryRelation: Exact rewrite replays once; changed source/destination/value rejects.

durable-protocol.inputMapping: Base revision/root, intent fingerprint, complete next-world plan, component roots, operation ID, and failpoint stage map to applying/published/completed/aborted protocol state.
durable-protocol.rejectionRelation: Concurrent applying owner, root mismatch, missing/corrupt component, publish-after-abort, or abort-after-publication rejects.
durable-protocol.resultMapping: Storage observations map to invisible staged state, exact published world, compact replay receipt, terminal abort, or repair outcome.
durable-protocol.retryRelation: Exact begin/complete retry returns frozen plan/receipt; changed fingerprint or stale base rejects.

external-plugin-boundary.inputMapping: Application callback identity/provenance is retained, while callback execution itself is outside the model.
external-plugin-boundary.rejectionRelation: Unbounded/nondeterministic/external effects are unsupported and must be caught by application plugin tests.
external-plugin-boundary.resultMapping: Only validated deterministic callback output enters the migration abstraction.
external-plugin-boundary.retryRelation: Repeated callback execution must be deterministic under bounded source snapshots.

facade-construction.inputMapping: Catalogue, storage, clock, and deficit policy bind the implementation environment without publishing stock.
facade-construction.rejectionRelation: Unsupported storage guarantees or invalid catalogues reject at their own validators.
facade-construction.resultMapping: Constructed facade exposes checked grouped APIs and an unchanged initial world.
facade-construction.retryRelation: Construction has no durable retry identity.

fungibility-movement.inputMapping: Frozen pool revision/request/scope/method maps to exact member allocations and one issue/transfer/scrap event.
fungibility-movement.rejectionRelation: Shortfall, expired stock, package increment mismatch, reservation conflict, or unknown member rejects atomically.
fungibility-movement.resultMapping: Result maps to exact member lines, pool contribution, event kind, published revision, and replay.
fungibility-movement.retryRelation: Exact intent replays once; changed pool revision/request/scope/method rejects.

fungibility-read.inputMapping: Pool revision, exact basis quantity, scope, method, and eligibility flags map to revision-frozen member candidates.
fungibility-read.rejectionRelation: Unknown revision/member, incompatible basis, impossible increment, expired/disallowed, or reservation-blocked input rejects or reports shortfall.
fungibility-read.resultMapping: Definition, summary, or plan preserves member identities, basis conversions, sources, shortfall, and expiry exclusions.
fungibility-read.retryRelation: Read/plan is side-effect-free and deterministic for one snapshot.

identity-normalization.inputMapping: Identity and selector fields map to finite model atoms and exact set constraints.
identity-normalization.rejectionRelation: Empty, duplicate, contradictory, or non-canonical identities reject.
identity-normalization.resultMapping: Result is a canonical collision-free identity/selector observation.
identity-normalization.retryRelation: Pure helper; retry is ordinary referential equality.

lot-command.inputMapping: Item/lot identity and asserted/corrected metadata map to one immutable lot master chain.
lot-command.rejectionRelation: Cross-item lot identity, invalid time, correction cycle, or stale root rejects.
lot-command.resultMapping: Result exposes effective lot metadata, retained correction provenance, event, revision, and replay without changing quantity.
lot-command.retryRelation: Exact lot command replays once; changed metadata under one operation identity rejects.

migration-definition.inputMapping: Typed query/plugin declarations and opening/traceability facts map to a deterministic finite migration declaration and diagnostics.
migration-definition.rejectionRelation: Unknown query, duplicate source identity, ambiguity, invalid unit/graph/vector, or paging limit rejects/blocks.
migration-definition.resultMapping: Result is a frozen declaration/plan/source bundle or explicit blockers; no target world changes.
migration-definition.retryRelation: Equal bounded source rows produce the same digests and declaration.

migration-publication.inputMapping: Migration ID, source/plan/catalog digests, ordered operations, dry-run roots, and complete target world map to one atomic migration manifest.
migration-publication.rejectionRelation: Blocked diagnostics, dry-run mismatch, source drift, stale/nonempty target, corrupt staged world, or aborted identity rejects.
migration-publication.resultMapping: Result maps to dry-run comparison, one published target revision/root, compact manifest, replay, repair, or safe abort.
migration-publication.retryRelation: Exact manifest retry resumes/publishes the same batch; changed plan/catalog/source under one migration ID rejects.

operation-result-helper.inputMapping: Operation/request/group references map to deterministic result partitioning and retained event identity.
operation-result-helper.rejectionRelation: Missing/duplicate/foreign request evidence rejects before application consumption.
operation-result-helper.resultMapping: Result preserves operation/group/request identities, exact allocations, event, receipt, and replay observation.
operation-result-helper.retryRelation: Equal frozen references regroup equal evidence; unknown or duplicate references reject.

packaging-reclassification.inputMapping: Loose/package amounts and exact package revision map to a whole-unit preserving pack/unpack rewrite.
packaging-reclassification.rejectionRelation: Fractional package, incompatible revision, insufficient contents, or non-conserving vector rejects.
packaging-reclassification.resultMapping: Result changes exact package bucket while preserving resolved primary and independent measurements.
packaging-reclassification.retryRelation: Exact conversion replays once; changed package revision/count/source rejects.

pure-exact-value.inputMapping: Exact decimal/unit/package inputs map directly to finite quantity or measurement tuples.
pure-exact-value.rejectionRelation: Malformed decimals, unit mismatches, fractional packages, and ambiguous conversions reject before state.
pure-exact-value.resultMapping: Pure output is the exact normalized value; no world changes.
pure-exact-value.retryRelation: No durable identity; equal input produces equal output.

read-current.inputMapping: Selector/identity/scope/time fields map to a query over one fully published abstract world.
read-current.rejectionRelation: Unknown identity or invalid selector/time rejects; reads never fall back to staged or compatibility truth.
read-current.resultMapping: Read result maps to exact current positions, summaries, availability, plans, metadata, claims, counts, or events from one world revision.
read-current.retryRelation: Reads are side-effect-free; repeated reads without publication are equal.

read-snapshot.inputMapping: One public snapshot freezes one published world revision and its catalogue/projection/books.
read-snapshot.rejectionRelation: No staged component may appear; corrupt/missing published roots fail closed.
read-snapshot.resultMapping: Every snapshot method reports observations from the same worldRevision even if later publications occur.
read-snapshot.retryRelation: Snapshot methods are synchronous and repeatable over frozen state.

reservation.inputMapping: Reservation identity, revision, broad selector, requested quantity, lifecycle time, allocations, and fulfillment map to one claim lifecycle transition.
reservation.rejectionRelation: Infeasible allocation, out-of-scope source, double consume, invalid lifecycle time, or terminal transition rejects.
reservation.resultMapping: Result maps to exact reservation state/allocations, optional issue event, revision, and replay.
reservation.retryRelation: Exact lifecycle intent replays once; changed claim/request/allocation/fulfillment under the same operation ID rejects.

scrap.inputMapping: Exact or policy-selected source amounts map to explicit destructive resource effects with reason/evidence.
scrap.rejectionRelation: Deficit, package mismatch, reservation conflict, or disallowed source rejects atomically.
scrap.resultMapping: Result maps to one scrap event and exact decrements; nothing disappears without the event.
scrap.retryRelation: Exact scrap intent replays once; changed source/amount/method rejects.

stock-issue.inputMapping: Exact source position and amount map to subtractive effects over one immutable resource bucket.
stock-issue.rejectionRelation: Deficit, package mismatch, expired/disallowed stock, or reservation infeasibility rejects atomically.
stock-issue.resultMapping: Result maps to one issue event, exact decrements, revision, and replay.
stock-issue.retryRelation: Exact issue intent replays once; changed source/amount/context rejects.

stock-policy-issue.inputMapping: Selector/request groups, revision, FIFO/FEFO method, expiry, reservation flags, and configured deficit policy map to exact physical allocation plus either no shortfall or one explicit signed non-allocatable deficit.
stock-policy-issue.rejectionRelation: Reject mode preserves the old fail-closed shortfall stutter; Record mode records only genuine stock shortfall, while package ambiguity, expiry, allocation constraints, and reservation conflicts still reject atomically.
stock-policy-issue.resultMapping: Result maps request/group identities to exact allocated positions/amounts, optional durable deficit evidence, one published event, and replay identity.
stock-policy-issue.retryRelation: Exact intent replays identical allocations and deficit evidence; changed request order/content/method/deficit position rejects.

stock-policy-transfer.inputMapping: Selector/request groups, method, and destination map to exact sources plus one atomic location rewrite.
stock-policy-transfer.rejectionRelation: Shortfall, expiry, package increment, reservation conflict, or invalid destination rejects with no partial transfer.
stock-policy-transfer.resultMapping: Result maps groups to exact sources, one transfer event, unchanged global quantity, and published revision.
stock-policy-transfer.retryRelation: Exact batch intent replays identical allocation evidence; changed request/destination/method rejects.

stock-receipt.inputMapping: Destination identity, exact amount/package, lot/container/dimensions, and command header map to additive resource effects.
stock-receipt.rejectionRelation: Invalid amount, package identity, duplicate/conflicting destination, or stale base rejects before visible state.
stock-receipt.resultMapping: Result maps to one receipt event, exact effects, published revision, and replay flag.
stock-receipt.retryRelation: Exact receipt intent replays once; changed line/order/amount/metadata under the same operation ID rejects.

stock-transfer.inputMapping: Exact source, destination location, and amount map to one atomic location rewrite preserving all other dimensions.
stock-transfer.rejectionRelation: Deficit, package mismatch, invalid destination, or stale base rejects atomically.
stock-transfer.resultMapping: Result maps to one transfer event and equal global quantity before/after.
stock-transfer.retryRelation: Exact transfer intent replays once; changed destination/source/amount rejects.

storage-integrity.inputMapping: World/catalog/projection/reservation/count roots and deltas map to canonical abstract component identities.
storage-integrity.rejectionRelation: Malformed deltas, missing rows, root mismatch, or invalid begin input rejects.
storage-integrity.resultMapping: Result is deterministic digest/delta/materialized world matching the frozen plan.
storage-integrity.retryRelation: Pure integrity helpers are deterministic; durable exact retries compare the same roots.

traceability.inputMapping: Node identities, relation kind/action, source provenance, and command header map to one graph edge transition.
traceability.rejectionRelation: Cycle, self-edge, invalid node kind, duplicate/inconsistent relation, or genealogy without transformation rejects.
traceability.resultMapping: Result exposes exact relation change, graph state, event, revision, and replay without inventing stock effects.
traceability.retryRelation: Exact relation intent replays once; changed kind/action/endpoints rejects.

transfer-lifecycle.inputMapping: Transfer identity, source/transit/destination, exact lines, custody, receipt quantities, and immutable operation intent map to one time-separated physical transfer lifecycle.
transfer-lifecycle.rejectionRelation: Insufficient source, existing transfer identity, pre-dispatch receipt, post-dispatch release, over-receipt, cross-transfer receipt, package/line collapse, reservation conflict, or stale publication rejects atomically.
transfer-lifecycle.resultMapping: Result maps to exact prepared/dispatched/received/remainder state plus immutable stock event and replay truth.
transfer-lifecycle.retryRelation: Exact prepare/dispatch/receive/release retry stutters or replays; changed intent under one operation identity rejects.

transformation.inputMapping: Consume/produce lines and genealogy nodes map to an explicit atomic transformation relation; no generic conservation is inferred across different items unless declared by exact vectors.
transformation.rejectionRelation: Duplicate identity, impossible source, invalid graph, or malformed exact measurements rejects atomically.
transformation.resultMapping: Result maps to exact consumed/produced buckets and genealogy edges.
transformation.retryRelation: Exact transform intent replays once; changed line/vector/genealogy rejects.

transformation-read.inputMapping: Exact transformation identity or revision plus one published world maps to retained definitions and current exact input stock.
transformation-read.rejectionRelation: Unknown revisions, item/form mismatches, invalid selectors, and insufficient input stock reject or report not applicable without writing.
transformation-read.resultMapping: Definition reads retain immutable revision meaning; planning reports one published world revision, exact required/current vectors, and no stock write.
transformation-read.retryRelation: Repeated reads and plans over one published world return the same retained definitions and physical inputs.
